newsitem.title: USA: A.D. Tech CEO buys 12,000 A.D. Tech shrs.
newsitem.headline: A.D. Tech CEO buys 12,000 A.D. Tech shrs.

text.p: Advanced Deposition Technologies Inc said on Friday that its president and chief executive officer, Glenn Walters, had purchased 12,000 shares of its common stock.
Walters, who filed a Form 4 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, is one of A.D. Tech's largest shareholders and the company's founder, it said.
A.D. Tech is a technology company that develops and commercializes new products and technologies related to thin films, coatings, dielectrics and vapor depositions.
